description:
The Vibe Shipped 50: apps built with AI coding tools, ranked by stated, sourced monthly USD revenue.
Use when: the user asks how much vibe-coded apps earn, or for the top earners built with a tool.
Do not use for: finding apps by keyword (search_apps).
Returns: apps[] with rank, title, revenue_stated, monthly_usd, evidence_tier, revenue_date, stale flag, source_url, link; total_ranked. include_unranked adds notable unranked apps and the method.
Limits: limit 1-50, default 20. Always say figures are as stated and give the evidence tier.
Example: {"tool":"cursor","limit":10}

tool.description: Only apps built with this tool id, e.g. cursor.

name: get_vibe50
title: The Vibe Shipped 50
